post.description: One page (10) of the public complaint history for a BBB business identified by profile URL or bbb_id + business_id: complaint type, status, date, redacted text and business/consumer responses, with per-type and per-status counts, optional type/status filters, and the profile's complaint totals (all, closed in 3 years, closed in 12 months).

url.description: HTTPS www.bbb.org/{us|ca}/<state>/<city>/profile/<category>/<name>-<bbb_id>-<business_id> profile URL (section suffixes such as /complaints are accepted). Provide either url, or bbb_id with business_id.

bbb_id.description: 4-digit BBB office id from search results, e.g. 0825. Provide together with business_id.

business_id.description: Numeric BBB business id from search results, e.g. 90019908. Provide together with bbb_id.

country.description:
Only with bbb_id/business_id: which BBB site holds the profile.

Provider reference: allowed values ["us", "ca"]; default "us".

page.description:
Page number, 1 to 100 (10 per page, newest first).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 1.

complaint_type.description: BBB complaint type slug as returned in filters.type: billingissues, serviceorrepair, productissues, order, customerservice, salesadvertising, delivery, facilities and others.

status.description: BBB complaint status slug as returned in filters.status: answered, resolved, unanswered, unpursuable.

post.description: Find BBB business profiles by business name or category near a place (US or Canada). Returns one page of 15 results with each business's BBB letter grade, accreditation flag, categories, address, phones, coordinates and profile URL, plus totals for pagination. BBB's matching is fuzzy: check the returned name.

query.description: Business name or category, 1 to 200 characters, e.g. roofing, Comcast, moving company.

location.description: City and state/province (Austin, TX) or postal code, up to 120 characters. Omit for a nationwide search.

country.description:
Which BBB site to search.

Provider reference: allowed values ["us", "ca"]; default "us".

page.description:
Results page, 1 to 100 (15 results per page).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 1.

sort.description:
Result order.

Provider reference: allowed values ["Relevance", "Distance", "Rating", "AToZ", "ZToA"]; default "Relevance".
